items.title: Bat Swooping Above Reeds
items.alt: A long-winged bat skims above three broad reed stems with feet tucked and muzzle angled down, isolated without a sky or water rectangle.
items.description: A long-winged bat skims above three broad reed stems with feet tucked and muzzle angled down, isolated without a sky or water rectangle. Useful for night nature stories.

items.title: Bat Landing on a Twig
items.alt: A small bat folds its wings while reaching its two hind feet toward a slanted twig, captured at the moment before gripping.
